abstract: The process of differentiation of embryoid bodies of mouse teratocarcinoma OTT6050 transplanted into the lung of syngeneic mice (129/Sv) is described. Embryoid bodies took more than 2 weeks to differentiate, and several kinds of differentiated tissues appeared often in the colonies derived from a single embryoid body. All the colonies with differentiated tissues were larger than 100μm in diameter. Three steps on the differentiation of embryoid bodies can be distinguished by microscopic observations on histological preparations of tumors at different periods after injection. The first step is the deformation of the embryoid bodies and the disappearance of the outer endodermal cells, which occurs within a few days after injection. In the second step, which begins 5-7 days after injection, clusters of embryonal carcinoma cells in the colony are identified by the PAS reaction. The third step starts about 10 days after injection, and is characterized by the formation of tubular structures in some clusters.
abstract_ja: 同系マウス(129/Sv)の肺に移植したマウス奇形癌OTT6050の胚様体の分化過程を記述する。胚様体が分化するまでに2週間以上を要し、単一の胚様体に由来するコロニーには、しばしばいくつかの種類の分化組織が出現した。分化組織を含むコロニーはすべて直径100μm以上であった。注射後の異なる時期の腫瘍の組織標本の顕微鏡観察により、胚様体の分化には3段階が区別できる。第1段階は、注射後数日以内に起こる胚様体の変形と外側の内胚葉細胞の消失である。第2段階は注射後5～7日目から始まり、PAS反応によりコロニー内の胎児性癌細胞の集塊が同定される。第3段階は注射後約10日目に始まり、一部の集塊で管状構造の形成によって特徴づけられる。
